name: Kayce Discount Rules – Dynamic & Tiered Pricing for WooCommerce
author: wpkayce

sections.description:
Documentation | Plugin page | Black Friday sale guide | Support

Kayce Discount Rules lets you run sales, tiered pricing and order discounts in WooCommerce without coupon codes. Customers see the discounted price in the shop, on the product page, and in the cart.

Everything below is in the free plugin, with no limit on the number of rules.

Rule types

  • Product discount – a percentage off, a fixed amount off, or a fixed price on every product you choose.
  • Bulk pricing – quantity tiers such as “5–9 items: 10% off, 10 or more: 20% off”. Count quantity per product, per variation, or across every matching item so customers can mix and match (“any 6 bottles from the Wine category”).
  • Cart discount – a percentage or fixed amount off the cart, with an optional minimum such as “10% off orders over $100”. It shows as its own line in the cart and checkout totals.

Schedule your sales

  • Give any rule a start and end date and time, so a Black Friday sale starts and stops on its own
  • A ready-made Black Friday template fills in the dates for you

Choose what each rule applies to

  • All products, specific products, categories, tags or brands
  • Exclude products or categories
  • Skip products that are already on sale

On the storefront

  • Struck-through original prices in the shop, on product pages and in the cart
  • Sale badges with the percentage saved (badge text is configurable)
  • A quantity pricing table on the product page that highlights the tier the shopper’s quantity falls into
  • “Add 2 more to get 15% off” messages on the product page and in the cart, which update as the quantity changes
  • A “You save” line in the cart and checkout totals
  • A Quantity Pricing Table block for block themes and a [kayce_discount_table] shortcode for everything else

Easy to set up

  • Start from ready-made templates: Black Friday sale, spend and save, store-wide sale, category sale, buy more save more, mix and match, wholesale pricing, clearance price
  • A live preview shows exactly what shoppers will see, with a quantity simulator, before you save
  • Clear warnings for overlapping tiers, gaps and missing products
  • See how many orders each rule discounted and how much customers saved in the last 30 days
  • Drag and drop to reorder rules, pause or duplicate them in one click

Built for modern WooCommerce

  • Works with the Cart and Checkout blocks and with the classic shortcodes
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • The rule each order line was priced by is saved on the order and shown in the admin
  • When two rules match the same item, the customer gets the better price
  • Fully translatable and RTL-ready, with an admin built from WordPress components

Pro

Kayce Discount Rules Pro adds Buy X Get Y, free gifts, conditions (cart subtotal, item count, user role, first order, weekday and time-of-day schedules), and control over how rules stack. Rules you create in the free plugin keep working when you add Pro.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Kayce Discount Rules from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Discount Rules and click Add rule.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Discounted prices are applied when WooCommerce calculates the cart, so the blocks show them, including their own “Save” badge on each line.

What happens if two rules match the same product?

The customer gets the lowest price. If two rules give the same price, the rule higher in the list wins. Pro adds “apply by priority” and “stack all discounts”.

Can a sale start and end automatically?

Yes. Set a start and end date in step 3 of a rule. Times use your store’s timezone. If you use full-page caching, cached product pages may show the old price for a short while after a sale starts or ends. The cart and checkout always charge the right price.

Can shoppers use a coupon as well?

Yes. Rules and coupons work side by side. Restrict your coupons in WooCommerce if you don’t want them combined.

Does it change my product prices?

No. Stored prices are never changed. Discounts are calculated on display and in the cart, so turning a rule off restores the normal price immediately.

Can I move or restyle the pricing table?

Choose its position under Settings, hide it and place the block or shortcode yourself, or copy templates/pricing-table.php to yourtheme/woocommerce/kayce-discount-rules/pricing-table.php and edit it.

Is the source code for the admin screen available?

Yes. The uncompiled JavaScript is in the src folder of the plugin. Run npm install && npm run build to rebuild build/.

Does the plugin contact any external service?

No. Everything runs on your own site.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Renamed to Kayce Discount Rules – Dynamic & Tiered Pricing for WooCommerce. Your rules and settings are unchanged.
  • Added Documentation and Support links on the Plugins screen and the Discount Rules screen.
  • Performance: stores with no active rules now skip discount checks on prices, sale badges and cart messages, and the rule list is read once per page.
  • Uninstalling now also removes cached usage stats.
  • Security review: checked permissions, input handling and output escaping, with no problems found.
  • Translations: the note for translators on the “Add more” message now reaches them, and the translation template is updated.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.2 on PHP 8.1 to 8.4.

1.1.0

  • New: schedule any rule with a start and end date and time.
  • New: Cart discount rule type, with an optional minimum cart subtotal.
  • New: target products by tag or brand.
  • New: “Add 2 more to get 15% off” messages on the product page and in the cart. Turn them off under Settings.
  • New: Black Friday sale and Spend and save templates.
  • Usage stats now include cart discounts.

1.0.0

  • First release: product discounts, bulk and tiered pricing, rule templates, live preview, usage stats, sale badges, pricing table block and shortcode, Cart and Checkout block support.
